svg.title: The Methodology and WYBE Support Levels & Primary Offerings
svg.desc: Deep Baseline Assessment. Every plan begins by evaluating movement, injury history, sleep, workload, and nutrition. Iterative 12-24 Week Cycles. Plans are continuously revised based on real data and direct client feedback. Mind Coaching for Focus. Focus is treated as a masterable skill to prevent the loss of motivation. Self-Starter: Structured Workout Programs. Best For: Those looking for a clear, science-backed plan. Focused Support: Fitness Consultations. Best For: Individuals hitting a plateau in their current routine. High-Touch: 1-on-1 Performance Mentorship. Best For: Exclusive, limited-entry coaching for maximum focus.
